dataset: Same frozen 172 validation images, 204 instances, 8 species; decoded pixels checked across sources
AP: pycocotools COCOeval; 101 recall points; IoU 0.50 for mAP50 and 0.50:0.05:0.95 for mAP; maxDets=[1,10,100] per category
additional_dedup: All generations use original score-priority non-transitive class-agnostic IoU>=0.5 suppression, before classifier

ranking_score.gen1: native joint localization/species score; no separate classifier
ranking_score.gen2_gen3_gen4: detector_score * classifier_top_score, as fourth-generation primary result

crop: Existing per-model preprocessing, 15% box expansion for all stage-two classifiers; CNN uses original integer truncation; BioCLIP floor/ceil
operating_point: native detector score strictly >0.30, IoU>=0.5 matching
image_exact_accuracy: All annotated birds correctly located and classified, no extra predicted boxes, divided by 172; assessed against frozen XML
matched_box_classification_accuracy: Correct species among geometry-matched bird boxes / number of geometry-matched boxes; includes all 8 species and all 172 images, excludes unmatched boxes from denominator
limitations: Reused validation set, not an independent test.
Annotation omissions can make correct detections disagree with XML.
Historical weights and training manifests differ across generations; metric standardization does not equal identical training budget.
Native model scores are not equally calibrated; threshold 0.30 is a shared operating point, not an equivalent probability.
Historical native outputs are retained; first and PP use 640, RF uses 512.
